title: Build durable multi-audio course workflows
summary: Support multiple recordings per class and course with persistent jobs, retry, resume, merged timeline, and course-level notes.
acceptanceCriteria: Multiple audio files can be appended to one class without losing source identity.
Jobs survive reload and can resume or retry per file.
Course-level summaries preserve recording and timestamp citations.
A complete backup restores courses, metadata, transcripts, notes, and audio.
Database migration is tested against the current schema.
npm run check and npm run build pass.
